title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House, University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
lineage: Used Diamond Cut/Forensics 8.1 to clean up the monitor noise (sounds like an unshielded cable) and a little of the over saturation (analog recorder clipping) on the source

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording praised as great, though reviewers give no specifics on the musical performance.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers gave five‑star ratings and repeatedly say the audio "sounds great" and they enjoy it a lot. No comments are made about the band's playing, setlist flow, or individual songs, so the assessment of the show itself is neutral.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores and explicit praise for sound quality push the rating up, but lack of detail about the performance limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "great" and have no complaints; no specific technical issues mentioned.
